_comment: LM Studio: open the Program tab, choose Install > Edit mcp.json, and merge one of the entries below. 'astro-rag-local' connects to a server started with 'python launch.py'; 'astro-rag-hosted' needs no installation. Then load a tool-capable model (e.g. a Qwen 3 instruct model) and enable the astro-rag tools in the chat.
